title: 22-home project for adults with disabilities
summary: The disability commission is reviewing a proposed 22-home project with seven licensed homes for adults with disabilities and 17 affordable rentals open to anyone. A commissioner said federal funds may mean homes cannot be limited to people with disabilities, and the item stays on the agenda.

timeline.text: Proposed housing development item: The chair kept the proposed housing project on the agenda for more discussion without a motion.
A commissioner said federal housing funds may mean the homes cannot be limited to people with disabilities.
A proposed housing project has 22 homes: seven for adults with disabilities and 17 affordable rentals open to anyone.
Seven homes are licensed homes for adults with disabilities, with live-in caregivers.
The chair asked whether the project has reached agencies with waiting lists of families needing accessible homes.
The chair said the land lease calls for the homes to be mainly for people with disabilities.
